name.description: The workspace name the provision command carries as its name suffix. The installer sets it from the command name.

command.description: The workspace provision command's flat data, verbatim. The installer sets it from the command.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the workspace PVCs. Empty uses the cluster default StorageClass.

instructions.description: Object-storage delivery of instruction content. The harness init container syncs each workspace's prefix from this endpoint/bucket using the named read-only credential; the serving container mounts the result read-only and holds no credential.

endpoint.description: Cross-namespace Service address (host:port) of the shared cluster object store the sync init container reaches. The harness egress netpol reads the store namespace from this host.

bucket.description: Bucket holding every workspace's instruction tree.

credentialName.description: Name of the Secret carrying the read-only, prefix-scoped sync credential, which the operator creates in the tenant namespace. Mounted into the init container only.

syncImage.description: Image for the object-storage sync init container (carries the sync client).
